title: freetokens offer front-matter
description: Strict schema for offers/*.yaml front-matter. One flat key/value document per offer; the file name (without extension) is the offer slug. Regular offers carry only the required fields; the optional community fields (#748) are valid only together with listing_type: community.

title.description: Human-readable offer name shown on cards.

provider.description: Company or product offering the credit.

amount.description: Free value in human terms, e.g. '$300 in credits'.

expiry_date.description: Date the offer stops being claimable, YYYY-MM-DD. Use explicit null for ongoing offers.

source_url.description: Official provider page describing the offer.

verified_date.description: Date the curator last verified the offer is live, YYYY-MM-DD. Not nullable.

verification.description: How the listing was checked: social_proof = corroborated by official-site info plus social proof, not personally verified; unverified = only social-media proofs, no official-website confirmation.

review_status.description: Curator testing state: verified = reviewed firsthand, unverified = not reviewed firsthand, under-review = currently being tested, to-be-verified = current details need follow-up. This is separate from verification evidence level and offer expiry.

signup.description: Whether claiming needs an account: none = claimable without sign-up; required = needs a (free) account.

listing_type.description: Omit for a regular offer (the default). community = a promo code or giveaway a person shared publicly (#748): NOT verified by freetokens, added only by Luong through a small entry PR, never created, edited or re-checked by the offer-hunter or the daily-offer-check. source_url is the post itself. Every fact is quoted from the post; anything the post does not state stays absent.

community_subtype.description: Community only. promo_code = a code anyone can redeem; giveaway = codes handed out to people who reply or enter.

added_by.description: Community only. Who added the entry; Luong is the only one allowed.

shared_by_handle.description: Community only. The poster's bare account handle (no @). The index re-nests it as community.shared_by.handle.

shared_by_name.description: Community only, optional. The poster's display name as shown on the post.

shared_by_post_date.description: Community only. Date of the post, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC).

promo_code.description: promo_code subtype only, and required there. The code exactly as the post gives it. Its stated expiry goes in expiry_date (null = the post states none).

codes_available.description: giveaway subtype only, optional. How many codes the post says it gives away (a whole number; the flat YAML stores it as text, the index as an integer).

entries_close.description: giveaway subtype only, optional. The day entries close, YYYY-MM-DD. expiry_date must equal it: the build drops the entry once that day has ended on the UTC build clock (end of day when the post names no time zone).

timezone_note.description: Community only; required with entries_close. The post's time zone quoted, or 'no time zone given'.
